import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01'],
    'time': ['00:00', '02:00', '04:00', '06:00', '08:00'],
    'product': ['Cappuccino', 'Cappuccino', 'Tea', 'Latte', 'Americano'],
    'size': ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small', 'Large', 'Medium'],
    'price': [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    'quantity': [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    'payment_method': ['Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Cash'],
    'customer_age_group': ['55+', '35-44', '18-24', '45-54', '45-54'],
    'is_takeaway': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'total': [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create datetime column for time series analysis
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set up the visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Sales by Product and Size
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_size_data = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack()
product_size_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#8B4513', '#D2691E', '#A0522D'])
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product and Size', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.legend(title='Size')

# 2. Sales Trend Over Time
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
ax2.plot(df['datetime'], df['total'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#2E8B57')
ax2.fill_between(df['datetime'], df['total'], alpha=0.3, color='#2E8B57')
ax2.set_title('Sales Trend Throughout the Day', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Time')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sales by Age Group
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
age_group_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#96CEB4']
age_group_sales.plot(kind='pie', ax=ax3, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('')

# 4. Payment Method Distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
payment_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#6A5ACD', '#9370DB'])
ax4.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 5. Quantity vs Price Scatter
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
scatter = ax5.scatter(df['price'], df['quantity'], s=df['total']*20, 
                      c=df['total'], alpha=0.7, cmap='YlOrRd', edgecolors='black')
ax5.set_title('Price vs Quantity (Bubble Size = Total)', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Price ($)')
ax5.set_ylabel('Quantity')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax5)
cbar.set_label('Total Sales ($)')

# 6. Summary Statistics Table
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
ax6.axis('tight')
ax6.axis('off')
summary_data = [
    ['Total Revenue', f"${df['total'].sum():.2f}"],
    ['Average Transaction', f"${df['total'].mean():.2f}"],
    ['Total Items Sold', f"{df['quantity'].sum()}"],
    ['Unique Products', f"{df['product'].nunique()}"],
    ['Takeaway Orders', f"{df['is_takeaway'].sum()}/{len(df)}"],
    ['Peak Hour', df.loc[df['total'].idxmax(), 'time']]
]
table = ax6.table(cellText=summary_data, 
                  cellLoc='left', 
                  loc='center',
                  colWidths=[0.6, 0.4])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(10)
table.scale(1, 2)
ax6.set_title('Key Metrics Summary', fontweight='bold', y=0.95)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
